instruction.text: Vervollständige den Lückentext, indem du den Infinitiv oder das Gerundium in die Lücke einsetzt.

atoms.b: Environmental protection is a shared responsibility. Therefore, we need ((++to_rethink rethinking)) our choices. Instead of ((++buying to_buy)) out-of-season produce with long transportation routes, try ((choosing to_choose)) seasonal and regional food. By ((++doing to_do)) so, you reduce the carbon footprint associated with your groceries. Apart from ((++changing to_change)) your consumption behaviour, consider using public transportation or biking instead of driving by car in order ((++to_burn burning)) less fossil fuels.

instruction.text: Ergänze den Dialog, indem du das gegebene Wort im Gerundium oder Infinitiv in die Lücke schreibst.

atoms.b: Hi Martha, do you like ((going to_go)) second-hand shopping?
Hey Arsenio! Yes, I absolutely love ((finding to_find)) unique pieces at thrift stores. It's much better than ((buying)) fast fashion labels.
Sounds nice. I've been thinking about ((trying)) it too, but I don't know where ((to_start)).
Have you thought about the possibility of ((searching)) online? There are good websites for second-hand clothing.
Well, I think this isn't for me. I want ((to_make)) the right choice and therefore need ((to_feel)) the fabric and try the clothes on.
I see. Are you maybe interested in ((checking_out)) the new local thrift shop together next weekend?
Sure! I could use some trainers. I have outgrown my old ones.
Cool, I'm looking forward to it. However, you should keep in mind that you don't have ((to_purchase)) something just because it's cheap and seems like a unique opportunity.
That's good advice. I believe instead of always just ((consuming)) it's more important ((to_reconsider)) our purchasing behaviour and decisions.
Absolutely! Unnecessarily buying second-hand pieces doesn't solve our society's problem of overconsumption. Still, it poses a real good alternative to buying new items.
I agree. I am trying ((to_make)) more sustainable decisions in the future. ((Questioning)) my consumption behaviour is one of them.
